# Currentworks source provenance

Water 0.1.0 and Trees 0.1.3 are reused from the owner's public prism-current/modules/environment library. These four implementation/entry files are byte-identical snapshots, not a rewritten copy or a second engine. source-lock.json records their upstream location, versions and Git/SHA-256 hashes. Original source headers remain intact.

This integration is specifically authorized by the repository owner. The selected upstream files do not supply a separate third-party license notice; no MIT or public-domain relicensing is asserted here. No external tree code or image library is imported. Rainward's existing Three.js r177 MIT license remains in ../LICENSE. The upstream was tested on r184; Rainward compatibility needs its own checks.
